departuresIntro: If these dates don't match your travel plans, no worries! Tours can be created for ANY day, and we will do our best to help match you with a group. Contact us via our booking page or on WhatsApp.
ridingNote: No riding experience needed - our guides will be with you every step of the way.
passportNote: Scanned copies of all participants' passports must be submitted at the time of booking.

pillars.title: Scenic Landscapes
pillars.text: Ride through alpine valleys, mountain passes and wide open pastures.

pillars.title: Nomadic Culture
pillars.text: Stay in a traditional yurt and experience warm local hospitality.

pillars.title: Horseback Adventure
pillars.text: A beautiful experience to explore the stunning Kyrgyz terrain.
